findings.reason: without a stated control the node cannot distinguish a real note-presence check from a gate that flags all documentation, so the gate half of the deliverable rests on a measure that may hold on unfixed code.
findings.text: §14's done-when names a revert-sensitive control for its writer arm ("It fails with the writer reverted to `template.documentation`") but the gate arm ("The gate flags documentation that lacks a selected note") carries none, so nothing shows the gate half of the node's guard fires rather than, say, an over-eager gate that flags documentation whether or not the note-check code is present
